payload.content: Output formatting (standing): plain terminal, simple words. When structured output is needed, use ASCII box tables (+--+ borders, | pipes, = under header, padded cells) and verify all lines equal width with a script before sending; never send an unchecked table. Prefer small split tables over one giant table. Proactively use tables for structured results without being asked.
